programme.title: Garasjen - Rally Monte Carlo Historiqe, Garasjebesøk i Kristiansand og ferdigstilling av Audien!
programme.desc: Ivar og Asgeir deltar i Rallye Monte Carlo Historique. Vi besøker garasjen til Melvin i Kristiansand. Asgeir har jobbet hardt for å få ferdig Audien sin. Nå er det klart for siste finish, før bilen skal EU-godkjennes.

programme.title: Garasjen - Pål Anders Ullevålseter, NTCC i Århus og en ødelagt kluch.
programme.desc: Vi blir med Asgeir Borgemoen inn i garasjene til en rekke motorentusiaster rundt om i Norge. Kjøretøyene og prosjektene varierer, men lidenskapen for prosjektene sine er like stor hos dem alle. Det er utrolig hva som skjuler seg bak en garasjeport!

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1980-1990
programme.desc: 80-tallet er preget av racinglegender. En ny verdensmester kommer på banen, og viser frem motorer med 1.200 hester. Porche 959 er den raskeste landeveisbilen i verden. Motorsport har mer å si enn noen gang, og tiårene er fyllt med store motorer.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1947-1960
programme.desc: På slutten av 1940 og 1950 går vi mot en ny start. Etter krigen nærmest stoppet bilutviklingen og produksjonen helt opp, men produsenter fra Frankrike, England og USA begynte sakte bygge biler til sivile igjen.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1960-1970
programme.desc: 1960-tallet er fargerikt og bilmarkedet vokser. Småbiler er blitt veldig populære, og middelklassen er på utkikk etter bil. Hvis du har råd, vil drømmen din gå i oppfyllelse.

programme.title: Milestones - Milestones 1970-1980
programme.desc: På 70-tallet utløste oljekrisen et produksjonsskjelv. Kundene endret kjøpsatferd og gjorde økonomiske småbiler til bestselgere. Sikkerhets aspekter ble mer og mer vanlig, og datateknologi ble brukt til å bygge biler.

programme.title: Fast Lap NOR - Hyundai i30 N Performance Fastback
programme.desc: Bilentusiast og racerbilsjåfør, Asgeir Borgemoen, tester forskjellige sportsbiler på bane i Mendig, Tyskland. Etter noen runder gir han nøkkelen videre til Christian Mendzel, en profesjonell tysk racerbilsjåfør, som tar bilen rundt banen for den ultimate farts-testen. Denne gangen: Hyundai i30 N Performance Fastback

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Skoda Fabia 1.0 TSI: Wozu eigentlich noch Golf?
programme.desc: Bloch testet den Skoda Fabia 1.0 TSI. Was bietet der Kleinwagen aus dem VW-Konzern? Alexander Bloch nimmt sich die aktuelle Generation des Fabias vor und testet in 10 Disziplinen die Qualitäten des Skoda.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Alpine A290 GTS vs. Renault 5: Wer ist hier der Hot-Hatch?
programme.desc: Die schärfste Version des Renault 5 hört auf den Namen Alpine A290 GTS. Ist die sportive Alpine-Bezeichnung berechtigt oder nur Marketing, um den R5 deutlich teurer zu verkaufen? Alexander Bloch macht den Check auf dem ADAC-Handlingkurs und prüft, ob die Alpine A290 GTS ein echter Hot-Hatch ist. Das wird gut!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Comeback des Wankelmotors - So funktioniert die Technik
programme.desc: Nach einem Jahrzehnt feiert der Wankelmotor sein Comeback! Das ungewöhnliche Motorkonzept hatte in der Vergangenheit einige Probleme, weshalb die Produktion eingestellt wurde. Wie ein Wankelmotor funktioniert, wo seine Schwachstellen sind und warum er im neuen Mazda MX-30 R-EV wieder eingesetzt wird, erfahrt ihr mit Alexander Bloch.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - 5 Fehler: Deshalb ist WLTP bei E-Autos Schwachsinn!
programme.desc: Mit dem WLTP-Verbrauch sollte alles besser werden: Endlich realistische Angaben zum Verbrauch eines Fahrzeugs und keine geschönten Mini-Verbräuche. Doch ist das wirklich so? WLTP ist vor allem für Verbrenner optimiert worden, für Elektro-Autos ist das Verfahren aus verschiedenen Gründen unbrauchbar. Die fünf größten WLTP-Fehler im Zusammenhang mit E-Autos hat Alex im Video.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Das Reifen-ABC: Alles, was ihr über Reifen wissen müsst!
programme.desc: Alexander Bloch ist zu Besuch bei Quick Reifendiscount in Gelsenkirchen. Passend zur Reifenwechselsaison klären wir euch auf, worauf es bei der Wahl der Reifen ankommt und wann es an der Zeit ist, eure Schlappen zu wechseln.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Stehen Hybrid-Autos vor dem Aus?
programme.desc: Der Hybrid, also die Kombination aus Verbrenner und Elektromotor, hat aufgrund seiner Eigenschaften einige Erfolge verzeichnet. Er führte die Kunden an die Elektromobilität heran, bot aber gleichzeitig die Sicherheit, auf Langstrecken ohne Bedenken und ohne ständige Pausen voranzukommen. Reine Elektroautos müssen sich heute dank höheren Reichweiten auch nicht mehr verstecken. Gerät der Hybrid zunehmend in Vergessenheit? Alexander Bloch klärt auf!

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Tesla Model 3 Highland: Weltklasse, aber patzt in manchen Sachen
programme.desc: Das Tesla Model 3 galt zeitweise als meistverkauftes Elektroauto in Deutschland und auf dem Kontinent. Was macht Tesla so besonders und was kann das neue Update? Alex Bloch bittet das frisch geliftete Tesla Model 3 Highland zum ersten Check.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - KIA EV6
programme.desc: Heute muss sich der KIA EV6 im E-Auto Supertest beweisen. Die Technik übernimmt er vom Bruder Hyundai Ioniq 5, doch die Form und Ausrichtung ist deutlich sportlicher. Reicht das für ein gutes Ergebnis beim E-Auto Supertest?

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Mini E
programme.desc: Mini schickt den Mini Cooper SE zum E-Auto-Supertest. Im Gepäck hat der kleine Stromer neben einem Mini-Akku auch einige Überraschungen - sowohl positiv als auch negativ. Wie schneidet er im E-Auto Supertest mit Alex Bloch ab?

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Porsche Taycan
programme.desc: Heute stellt sich der Porsche Taycan GTS Sport Turismo dem E-Auto Supertest mit Alexander Bloch. Wer rund 170.000 Euro investiert, so viel kostet der Testwagen, will tolle Qualität, hohe Dynamik und Technik vom Feinsten. Kann der Elektro-Porsche diesen Ansprüchen genügen?

programme.title: Vorfahrt
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto!

programme.title: Einzeltest
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Menzel fährt...
programme.desc: Christian Menzel ist Rennfahrer, Instruktor und Fahrer-Coac. In seinem Format „Menzel fährt…“ nimmt er vor allem Sportwagen unter die Lupe und erklärt anhand der PS-Boliden, worauf es beim dynamischen Fahren auf der Rennstrecke ankommt.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Back to the future
programme.desc: Ohne sie wären diese Filme undenkbar. Der DeLorean DMC 12 aus Zurück in die Zukunft und der Ecto1 aus Ghostbusters. Wir zeigen euch alle wichtigen Details zu den Autos und ihre Besonderheiten.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Der Bobby Car Test
programme.desc: Das Bobby Car ist so erfolgreich wie VW Käfer, Toyota Corolla oder Ford Model T: Über 20 Millionen Exemplare fahren oder fuhren in Kinderzimmern auf der Welt. Alex Bloch testet heute die wichtigsten Bobby Cars auf Herz und Nieren.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Tesla Model S Plaid
programme.desc: Das Model S Plaid ist Teslas rollender Superlativ. Mit 1020 PS soll es nichts geringeres sein als das schnellste Serienauto der Welt, zumindest wenn es um die Beschleunigung von 0 auf 100 km/h geht. Aber stimmt das wirklich? Beschleunigt das Model S Plaid tatsächlich in 2,1 Sekunden auf Landstraßentempo. Diesem und 8 weiteren Mythen und Irrtümern rund um das Tesla Model S Plaid geht Alexander Bloch in dieser Folge Bloch erklärt auf den Grund.

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Bugatti-Motor
programme.desc: Heute hat Alexander Bloch ein ganz besonderes Spielzeug: einen funktionsfähigen Nachbau des W16-Motors aus dem Bugatti Veyron. Gebaut von Turbo-Nerd und Saab-Motorenentwickler Per Gillbrandt. Alex zeigt euch die wichtigsten Details des exklusiven Miniatur-Nachbaus und klärt die wichtigste Frage: Wird er anspringen?

programme.title: Bloch spielt - Scaleart Unimog
programme.desc: Alex spielt heute mit dem Scaleart Unimog, ein echtes Manufaktur-Meisterwerk. Detailreicher und detailgetreuer geht es nicht. Wir zeigen alle Details und fahren den Unimog auch im Gelände.

programme.title: Menzel fährt...
programme.desc: Christian Menzel ist Rennfahrer, Instruktor und Fahrer-Coac. In seinem Format „Menzel fährt…“ nimmt er vor allem Sportwagen unter die Lupe und erklärt anhand der PS-Boliden, worauf es beim dynamischen Fahren auf der Rennstrecke ankommt.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - MG Marvel R
programme.desc: Mit dem MG Marvel R kommt das erste chinesische Elektro-Auto zum Supertest mit Alexander Bloch. Kann er den arrivierten Herstellern aus Südkorea, Amerika und Deutschland die Stirn bieten? Alex findet es heraus.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Genesis GV60
programme.desc: Genesis ist die Luxus-Tochter von Kia und Hyundai. Auf der gleichen Plattform wie KIA EV6 und Hyundai Ioniq5 kommt der Genesis mit 435 PS Leistung und soll in nur 4 Sekunden auf 100 km/h beschleunigen.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - BMW i4 40 iDrive
programme.desc: BMW stellt mit dem BMW i4 eDrive40 ein E-Auto auf einer Verbrennerplattform auf die Straße. Wie gut das funktionieren kann, testet Alexander Bloch. Denn die Konkurrenz Tesla Model 3 Long Range, der Genesis GV 60 oder der Hyundai Ioniq 5 haben im E-Auto-Supertest bereits ordentlich vorgelegt.

programme.title: Die 7
programme.desc: Brandaktuelle Tests, Service Informationen, die schnellsten Sportwagen der Welt – alles Wissenswerte und Spannende rund ums Auto.

programme.title: Menzel fährt...
programme.desc: Christian Menzel ist Rennfahrer, Instruktor und Fahrer-Coac. In seinem Format „Menzel fährt…“ nimmt er vor allem Sportwagen unter die Lupe und erklärt anhand der PS-Boliden, worauf es beim dynamischen Fahren auf der Rennstrecke ankommt.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Mercedes-Benz EQS450
programme.desc: Heute im E-Auto Supertest mit Alexander Bloch - der Mercedes-Benz EQS 450+. Der Schwabe rühmt sich das beste E-Auto der Welt zu sein. Aber stimmt das wirklich? Reicht eine theoretische Reichweite von bis zu 780 Kilometern aus, um ein gutes E-Auto zu sein? Alexander Bloch jagt den Elektro-Stern durch den Supertest und findet heraus wie gut der EQS wirklich ist.

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Audi Q4 50 e-tron
programme.desc: Auf dem MEB des Volkswagen-Konzerns entstehen zahlreiche E-Autos. Auch Audi nutzt die Plattform für den Q4 50 e-tron. Ist er damit nur ein teurer VW mit vier Ringen oder doch ein waschechter Audi? Alexander Bloch nimmt das Elektro-SUV genau unter die Lupe: Wie ist die Qualität? Wie gut ist die Bedienung? Welcher Verbrauch und welche Reichweite sind drin? Lädt der Audi Q4 50 e-tron wirklich schnell? Die Antworten gibt es im E-Auto-Supertest. Das wird gut!

programme.title: E-Auto Supertest - Der Fiat 500 Elektro
programme.desc: Fiat hat kräftig an seinem Kult-Mini - dem 500 - gefeilt. Die neue Generation kommt als vollelektrischer Kleinstwagen. Altbekanntes Design mit komplett neuer E-Technik. Kann der Italiener mit der Konkurrenz mithalten? Heute stellt sich der Fiat 500 Elektro dem E-Auto Supertest von Alexander Bloch. Wie gut lädt er? Wie groß ist die Reichweite? Wie sind Qualität und E-Auto-Ausstattung? Und vor allem: Wo findet er sich im Gesamt-Ranking wieder?

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Doppelkupplungsgetriebe
programme.desc: Das Doppelkupplungsgetriebe hat in vielen Modellen die klassische Wandler-Automatik abgelöst. Größter Vorteil: nahezu keine Zugkraftunterbrechung. Doch die Technik ist nicht unumstritten - gerade in Bezug auf Komfort und Haltbarkeit. Alexander Bloch erklärt die 6 größten Irrtümer zum Doppelkupplungsgetriebe.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Motor-Irrtümer
programme.desc: Egal ob Benziner, Diesel oder Elektro: Ohne Motor geht nichts. Dabei gibt es rund um die Motorentechnik viele Stammtischweisheiten: z.B. Hubraum ist durch nichts zu ersetzen. Aber ist das wirklich so? Alexander Bloch erklärt die 10 größten Irrtümer zu Downsizing, Turbo und Co.

programme.title: Bloch erklärt - Starter-Batterie
programme.desc: Es ist faszinierend: wir fahren mit modernsten Autos durch die Gegend, diskutieren über Lithium-Ionen-Akkus und trotzdem würde ohne eine jahrhundertealte Stromspeicher-Technologie quasi der komplette Autoverkehr stillstehen: Der Bleiakkumulator. Alt genug, damit sich eine Menge Irrtümer bilden konnten. Wir klären heute die 8 größten Irrtümer zur Starterbatterie und geben Tipps zum Tausch und zur Starthilfe.

programme.title: Attacco Alieno Su Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nel Febbraio del 1942 un oggetto non identificato cade su Los Angeles. Settant'anni dopo gli alieni tornano per completare l'attacco attraverso una grande navicella spaziale atterrata sulla città. Le forze armate di Los Angeles rimangono sconvolte in quanto i loro missili non rispondono più ai comandi. Chi la spunterà?

programme.title: Age Of Tomorrow
programme.desc: La Terra è invasa da Ufo che distruggono tutto quello che si muove. Mentre la battaglia infuria, un gruppo di astronauti riesce a entrare nella nave principale dove uno di loro scopre un portale che conduce al mondo degli alieni. Riesce appena ad avvertire qualcuno dei suoi superiori sulla Terra, prima che tutto il gruppo venga ucciso. Parte l'ultimo disperato tentativo per fermare l'invasione.

programme.title: Taking Earth - Caccia Sulla Terra
programme.desc: Elettrizzante film fantascientifico. La razza umana è in pericolo. Un'invasione aliena sta gettando l'intero pianeta nel caos e nella paura. Presto si rivela alle autorità in allarme che lo scopo di questa forza superiore è quello di trovare un solo uomo su 7 miliardi. L'unico in grado di sconfiggerli per sempre.

programme.title: Blackout - Invasion Earth
programme.desc: In un futuro prossimo, la Russia viene colpita da un blackout. Ogni comunicazione è interrotta, le città sono al buio. Nella nuova e inquietante dimensione d'isolamento milioni di persone impazziscono e muoiono per cause sconosciute. Chi si nasconde dietro il disfacimento della nazione e il collasso del mondo intero? A una squadra di eroi, il compito di salvare quel che rimane dell'umanità.

programme.title: Bestie Dall'abisso - Il Giorno Del Giudizio
programme.desc: 15 anni prima le creature demoniache provenienti dal sottosuolo invasero la Terra con l'obiettivo di eliminare completamente il genere umano. Ricordato come il Giorno del Giudizio dai sopravvissuti di quell'infernale olocausto, l'umanità riuscì a prevalere. Le creature ora son tornate. Una famiglia cerca di difendersi e di richiudere l'ingresso che permette ai mostri di raggiungere il pianeta.

programme.title: Absolon: Virus Mortale
programme.desc: Un virus ha infettato l'intera umanità e l'Absolon è un farmaco indispensabile per sopravvivere. Un agente di polizia inizia a indagare sull'omicidio di uno scienziato che stava lavorando a un antidoto contro il virus, arrivando a scoprire una cospirazione. Da quel momento diviene il bersaglio della società che monopolizza l'Absolon.

programme.title: Metal Tornado
programme.desc: Metal Tornado

programme.title: Apocalypse Earth - Apocalisse Sulla Terra
programme.desc: In seguito a un'invasione aliena, un gruppo di umani disperati fuggono dalla Terra e arrivano in un pianeta lontano. I rifugiati si ritroveranno ben presto a dover combattere per la propria sopravvivenza contro feroci e ostili creature.

programme.title: Attacco Alieno Su Los Angeles
programme.desc: Nel Febbraio del 1942 un oggetto non identificato cade su Los Angeles. Settant'anni dopo gli alieni tornano per completare l'attacco attraverso una grande navicella spaziale atterrata sulla città. Le forze armate di Los Angeles rimangono sconvolte in quanto i loro missili non rispondono più ai comandi. Chi la spunterà?

programme.title: Age Of Tomorrow
programme.desc: La Terra è invasa da Ufo che distruggono tutto quello che si muove. Mentre la battaglia infuria, un gruppo di astronauti riesce a entrare nella nave principale dove uno di loro scopre un portale che conduce al mondo degli alieni. Riesce appena ad avvertire qualcuno dei suoi superiori sulla Terra, prima che tutto il gruppo venga ucciso. Parte l'ultimo disperato tentativo per fermare l'invasione.

programme.title: Taking Earth - Caccia Sulla Terra
programme.desc: Elettrizzante film fantascientifico. La razza umana è in pericolo. Un'invasione aliena sta gettando l'intero pianeta nel caos e nella paura. Presto si rivela alle autorità in allarme che lo scopo di questa forza superiore è quello di trovare un solo uomo su 7 miliardi. L'unico in grado di sconfiggerli per sempre.

programme.title: Night Of The Wild
programme.desc: In una città apparentemente tranquilla, un meteorite produce un effetto pericoloso sui cani che si trasformano in assassini feroci. Con gli abitanti costretti a difendersi da quelli che un tempo erano gli amici più fedeli, la giovane Roslyn si ritrova a cercare un modo per sopravvivere. Cosa faresti al suo posto?

programme.title: 500 Mph Storm - Mega Tornado
programme.desc: Quando viene perso il controllo di un esperimento energetico, una gran quantità di uragani si abbatte sul Nord America. Un insegnante di scienze del liceo cercherà di mettere in salvo la sua famiglia prima dell'arrivo degli uragani, creando un "hypercane", un uragano potente abbastanza da annullare gli altri, ma in grado anche di cancellare gli Stati Uniti dalla faccia della Terra.

programme.title: Apocalypse Pompeii
programme.desc: Apocalypse Pompeii

programme.title: Asteroid Vs Earth
programme.desc: Per salvare la Terra dall'impatto disastroso con un immenso meteorite, scienza e forza militare si alleano creando un piano ingegnosissimo: far esplodere alcune testate nucleari, provocando terremoti così enormi da spostare l'asse terrestre.

programme.title: Meet China: Turning Villages into Stages, Taking Creativity to the World
programme.desc: In this episode of Meet China, we step into the frontlines of rural revitalization to see how a Gen-Z village chief is breathing new life into her hometown. We then visit the world’s toy capital, where Chinese manufacturing is turning culture and creativity into global stories. From a green beef cycle near Beijing to rice-prawn co-culture in Cambodia, this episode explores how technology, industry and cooperation are helping land thrive and livelihoods grow.

programme.title: BizTalk | AI talent race and the future of work
programme.desc: As artificial intelligence (AI) transforms industries worldwide, competition in AI is increasingly driven not only by technology, but also by talent, skills and workforce development. In this episode of BizTalk, CGTN's Lily Lyu speaks with industry leaders and universities, to explore how AI is reshaping talent demand across industries, and how China is building a broader AI talent pipeline for the future.

programme.title: Innovating at Scale: Behind the Scenes of AMNC26
programme.desc: Ahead of the World Economic Forum's (WEF) Annual Meeting of the New Champions, or known as the "Summer Davos" in Dalian, CGTN’s Michael Wang speaks with three key WEF organizers to explore what it takes to scale innovation in a rapidly changing world. This special discussion offers an exclusive behind-the-scenes look at how the WEF brings together innovators, businesses and policymakers to turn ideas into real-world change.

programme.title: China Agenda 2026
programme.desc: Special coverage of China's annual sessions of its top legislature and political advisory body, known as the "Two Sessions".

programme.title: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums
programme.desc: From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances. The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

programme.title: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends
programme.desc: For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing. In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

programme.title: Headline：A Chinese village run by a CEO
programme.desc: In a Dai village called "Manluanzhan" near China's southwestern border, a full-time rural CEO manages the books and coordinates business operations at homestays, cafés, breweries, and other shops. But how to benefit from rural tourism without losing the village charm? In Manluanzhan, a fresh experiment is unfolding – one where villagers remain participants, investors, and decision-makers, but a CEO enters the fray to help defend their interests.

programme.title: Global Business-American Edition Ep.2
programme.desc: Global Business is the flagship business show of CGTN English Channel, bringing you the latest economic data, business trends and policies.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: A dough figurine artist transcending tradition
programme.desc: A video that went viral during the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics captured a heartwarming moment – when Albert II, Prince of Monaco asked a Chinese dough figurine artist to make a second piece to take home for his twins. CGTN's Dong Xue sits down with the artist to learn more about his traditional craft.

programme.title: China Bound: Chongqing
programme.desc: Join us in southwest China's Chongqing, one of the world's biggest cities. From futuristic skylines and cyberpunk streets, to fire-breathing opera, spicy hotpot and kungfu tea, we're diving deep into this megacity the size of Austria.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.3
programme.desc: Inner Mongolia spans China from east to west. Little wonder then, that it's such a land of diversity - epic landscapes of forests, grasslands and deserts, Inner Mongolia has it all!

programme.desc: Inner Mongolia spans China from east to west. Little wonder then, that it's such a land of diversity - epic landscapes of forests, grasslands and deserts, Inner Mongolia has it all!

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: Kung Fu Wise II-6 Shandong Mantis Style
programme.desc: The final episode traces the cross-ocean transmission of Shandong Mantis Style. In the mountains of northern Italy, host Kleber visits Dante Basili, a veteran Italian practitioner in his sixties, who recounts travelling to China 36 years ago to learn Mantis Style and returning home to teach Chinese martial arts ever since. Kleber then heads to Shandong to meet Yu Bo and Yu Tao, sons of Mantis Style grandmaster Yu Hai. He witnesses a traditional apprenticeship ceremony and explores the style’s fighting essence: adopting its spirit rather than merely copying its form. The episode shows how Mantis Style has taken root and flourished in different cultural settings. Ultimately, this journey across Europe and Asia suggests that transmission is not only about techniques, but also about dialogue across time and distance, and a shared resonance of spirit between cultures.

programme.title: Foodwise: Eat Like Confucius
programme.desc: "Foodwise" host Tianran He explores the ancient town of Qufu, the birthplace of Confucius. Together with a 75th generation descendant of the sage himself, they explore one of Confucius' lifelong pursuits: To cultivate oneself for the betterment of others. From the sophisticated cooking techniques and dining etiquette of Confucian cuisine, which was used for banqueting emperors and aristocrats, to getting hands on with street food and local delicacies, Tianran explores how Confucius' ideals have permeated through modern day life in Qufu.

programme.title: Foodwise: The Herbal Way of Life
programme.desc: 'Medicine tonic is not as good as food tonic' - this Chinese saying is a core principle of Traditional Chinese Medicine. It is believed that the right diet and nourishment can cure and reverse the effects of disease, hence considered an inevitable source of natural health preservation. In this Foodwise episode, our hosts Tianran He and Eva May explore this ancient concept of medicine food homology as they taste their way through different herbs, chat to experts of Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) and visit venues that combine conventional principles with modern ideas. Dive deep into the origin of TCM with us as we learn about the harmony between man and nature and its application in modern functional foods!

programme.title: From Stone to Story
programme.desc: China's profound stone carving culture dates back to the Han Dynasty (202 BC – 220 AD) and flourished during the Tang Dynasty (618 – 907 AD), evolving into a distinctive art form and unique cultural practice. Among many places famous for stone carving, Hui’an County—through generations of dedicated artisans—has risen to prominence and earned the esteemed title of "World Capital of Stone Carving," awarded by the World Crafts Council. The county’s skilled stonemasons are celebrated for their ability to transform ordinary pieces of rock into beautiful works of art. This episode shines a spotlight on the intangible cultural heritage of Hui’an stone carving and reveals how it has been influenced by the area’s close proximity to the sea.

programme.title: A dough figurine artist transcending tradition
programme.desc: A video that went viral during the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics captured a heartwarming moment – when Albert II, Prince of Monaco asked a Chinese dough figurine artist to make a second piece to take home for his twins. CGTN's Dong Xue sits down with the artist to learn more about his traditional craft.

programme.title: China Bound: Chongqing
programme.desc: Join us in southwest China's Chongqing, one of the world's biggest cities. From futuristic skylines and cyberpunk streets, to fire-breathing opera, spicy hotpot and kungfu tea, we're diving deep into this megacity the size of Austria.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.1
programme.desc: Lhasa, set high on the “Roof of the World” in China’s southwest, is both the capital of Xizang Autonomous Region, and the spiritual heart of Tibetan culture. In this episode, host Tianran He ventures deep into the fabled Potala Palace, discovering ancient meditation caves, priceless relics and golden rooftops. Then, he tries his hand at Tibetan papermaking, learning how a poisonous ingredient is crucial for making paper that can survive for centuries. Finally, Tianran dons his apron and learns to make iconic Tibetan dishes, including one said to reveal your fortune!

programme.title: An Encounter with China’s Endangered Monkeys
programme.desc: In this episode, we head to Baima Snow Mountain Nature Reserve in Diqing Tibetan Autonomous Prefecture, Yunnan Province, to learn about and participate in the conservation work for the rare and precious national treasure: the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. The presenter ventures into the forest, experiences the daily life of local forest rangers, and witnesses the harmonious relationship between humans and monkeys. We interview "the Monkey Father"—Long Yongcheng, chief scientist of The Nature Conservancy (TNC) and leader of China's Primate Expert Group—who shares stories about the two decades of efforts dedicated to protecting the Yunnan snub-nosed monkey. We also go to the mountains to conduct research alongside young volunteers. Through these activities, we recognize the importance of environmental education for young people in promoting natural ecological balance and harmonious development.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.3
programme.desc: Inner Mongolia spans China from east to west. Little wonder then, that it's such a land of diversity - epic landscapes of forests, grasslands and deserts, Inner Mongolia has it all!

programme.title: Aerial China II-2 Ep.3
programme.desc: Inner Mongolia spans China from east to west. Little wonder then, that it's such a land of diversity - epic landscapes of forests, grasslands and deserts, Inner Mongolia has it all!

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.3
programme.desc: Inner Mongolia spans China from east to west. Little wonder then, that it's such a land of diversity - epic landscapes of forests, grasslands and deserts, Inner Mongolia has it all!

programme.title: A dough figurine artist transcending tradition
programme.desc: A video that went viral during the Beijing 2022 Winter Olympics captured a heartwarming moment – when Albert II, Prince of Monaco asked a Chinese dough figurine artist to make a second piece to take home for his twins. CGTN's Dong Xue sits down with the artist to learn more about his traditional craft.

programme.title: Three Gorges of Chongqing
programme.desc: In this episode, through the new fashion of five-star cruise tour on the Three Gorges, with comfortable and convenient high-end experiences, we take the audience to travel along the river, multi-dimensionally show the most spectacular and beautiful landscape gallery along the Yangtze River, feel the unique charm of canyons, rapids and cultural relics on both banks, and convey the new charm of Yangtze River cultural tourism.

programme.title: Kungfu-wise: Wing Chun
programme.desc: Martial arts lover Kleber Battaglia is on a mission: To seek out China's kungfu masters, and learn their secrets. From explosive Wing Chun to fluid Taiji Quan, slippery Snake Style to elegant White Crane, he'll learn hidden moves and ancient techniques for defeating powerful opponents. But ?there’s more to kungfu than combat: From culture and philosophy, to wellness and insights from the natural world, Kleber will discover that contained within every kick, strike and throw, is the condensed wisdom of the ancient masters. This is Kungfu-wise. Kleber travels to Foshan, the birthplace of Wing Chun. A practitioner of this style, he seeks out masters of two different lineages: Ip Man and Snake Style. First he visits the Ip Man lineage, based on the legendary kungfu master whose life story spawned hundreds of martial arts movies, with Bruce Lee counting among his students. With Ip Man Wing Chun, Kleber learns how to create powerful short strikes perfectly suited to fighting in Foshan’s narrow alleys. With Snake Style, he experiences unique training methods that give its practitioners superhuman flexibility, allowing them to stick to their opponents, and even fight on boats in canals

programme.title: Foodwise: Xilingol
programme.desc: The Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region is located in the northern part of China, stretching from northeast to southwest side. In Xilin Gol, the horses, sheep and cows could be found every where. The local cuisines here are so attractive to the tourists, such as the roasted lamb is a traditional local dish. And the fired stone fried lamb is so hard to find if you are not traveling to Inner Mongolia. Have you ever tried salted milk tea? Just join in this visual trip！

programme.title: Foodwise: Kunming
programme.desc: Join host Tianran He in Kunming, the capital of Yunnan province in southwest China. Named the Spring City for its perennially good weather, Kunming is one of China's most ethnically diverse cities, something that's reflected in its food: From boozy sticky rice for breakfast, to the famous "Crossing the Bridge" rice noodles, and evening barbecues, there's plenty on offer here. Also, it's mushroom season, and Tianran is taking to the hills to hunt for wild fungi – but he'll need a trusty friend to steer him away from the poisonous ones!

programme.title: The sound of casting
programme.desc: For centuries, the fires of craftsmanship have never faded in Pingyao. In this UNESCO World Heritage city once famed for trade, three ancient metalworking traditions — sword casting, gold and silver crafting, and iron forging — continue to thrive. This episode steps into the workshops where artisans shape metal with fire and devotion. Each blade’s edge, each ornament’s gleam, and each curve of wrought iron tells a story of resilience and artistry — revealing how the spirit of Pingyao’s craftsmanship still glows in the heart of time.

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of Tibetan antelopes
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: China Bound: Guangzhou
programme.desc: Join us in Guangzhou, a global manufacturing hub in south China with a population as large as New York’s. From browsing hip street markets to wholesale clothes shopping, sampling world-famous Cantonese cuisine, and visiting the childhood home of kungfu legend Bruce Lee, there is plenty to do during our stay.

programme.title: China Untapped: Xizang Ep.2
programme.desc: Tianran He explores Lhasa’s bustling Barkhor Street, where pilgrims, locals, and visitors alike circle its ancient lanes. This multicultural district, home to sacred temples and boutique shops, becomes the backdrop as Tianran dons traditional Tibetan attire for a photoshoot. Across the city, he meets high school students dancing for Douyin — China’s version of TikTok, blending street dance with traditional Tibetan moves. Finally, Tianran travels to the birthplace of Tibetan incense, where waterwheels still power this thousand-year-old craft.

programme.title: The Great Wall Homestay
programme.desc: In this episode of Travelogue, Tianran He's heading to the mountains on Beijing’s northern outskirts, to meet some people his age who have swapped city life for the chance to run guesthouses beside the Great Wall of China.

programme.title: Aerial China II Ep.4
programme.desc: Gansu, in China's northwest, is a land dominated by tremendous forces of nature: mountain ranges flanking north and south press to form the ancient Hexi Corridor, and, of course, the mighty Yellow River. Taking off in central Gansu, gliding over farmlands past and present, behold the Loess Plateau's hidden beauty as we go on a quest for an ancient city called Dunhuang...

programme.title: Harmony Keepers: Guardians of Tibetan antelopes
programme.desc: This documentary series pays tribute to the guardians of China’s rare wildlife and their habitats. Through the lens of ecological protection and preservation, the series features four iconic protected species in China: the Tibetan antelope, milu deer, black-necked cranes, and golden snub-nosed monkeys.

programme.title: Navigating the Hills of Chongqing
programme.desc: This episode explores the transportation ingenuity of Chongqing, the Fog City. Surrounded by mountains and rivers, this megacity solves topographic challenges with the Yangtze River Cableway, Asia's second-longest escalator, and a train passing through a building. From the dock culture at the confluence of two rivers to a logistics hub linking China and Europe, witness its transformation from an inland town to an economic center via the Go West policy.

programme.title: Las cosas como son
programme.desc: Jeronimo alquila habitaciones y revisa las pertenencias de las personas cuando no estan presentes. Sanna, una atractiva actriz noruega, entra en su vida y despierta algo nuevo en Jeronimo.

programme.title: Las razones de mis amigos
programme.desc: La amistad entre tres amigos entra en crisis por una deuda.

programme.title: 7 Soles
programme.desc: La cruel tragedia que sufren muchos inmigrantes indocumentados en el desierto de Arizona todos los dias.

programme.title: Fumata Blanca
programme.desc: Durante unas jornadas religiosas en Barcelona, en las que se trata sobre el aperturismo de la Iglesia Católica y la sucesión del Papa, unos turbios asuntos amenazan con desvelar una trama de corrupción de la todopoderosa institución Vaticana.

programme.title: Lleno de ruido y dolor
programme.desc: En la Patagonia de 1928, un joven inexperto se arrepiente de robar un banco junto con dos bandoleros cuando las cosas no resultan como esperaba.

programme.title: Vaho
programme.desc: Cinco historias interrelacionadas que ocurren en tres tiempos distintos, en una zona suburbana de la ciudad de México que está cargada de misticismo prehispánico, fervorosa devoción católica y los más agudos problemas urbanos de la actualidad.

programme.title: Locas y Atrapadas
programme.desc: Cinco mujeres atrapadas en un ascensor confiesan sus amargas experiencias de vida causadas por hombres malvados y la sociedad.

programme.title: Chuecatown
programme.desc: Víctor es un agente inmobiliario en el barrio de Chueca en Madrid. Pero esconde un terrible secreto; sus apartamentos se ponen a la venta cuando asesina a las ancianas propietarias y disfraza el crimen como suicidio.

programme.title: La Guerra de los Drones
programme.desc: La invasión llenó de humo y fuego el cielo, que ahora está repleto de naves que cosechan todos los recursos de la Tierra. Las ciudades en ruinas están patrulladas por drones que eliminan todo lo que consideran una amenaza. En medio del caos, un grupo de científicos supervivientes vive escondido en las entrañas de Los Ángeles, buscando la manera de derrotar a los drones y derribar las naves nodrizas.

programme.title: El Proyecto Supermente
programme.desc: El proyecto Supermente es un programa secreto del gobierno en la guerra psicotrónica que sale mal. Ahora hay que eliminar a todos los involucrados. Huyendo por su vida, Jennifer Gaines debe descubrir quién ha robado la tecnología con planes de usarla para poner a Estados Unidos de rodillas. Cuando los desastres comienzan de verdad, el secreto más oscuro del experimento comienza a desvelarse.

programme.title: American Yakuza
programme.desc: Un agente americano del FBI es atraído por la mafia japonesa -la Yakuza- en esta película de acción.

programme.title: El mundo del triasico
programme.desc: Los científicos consiguen dar vida a los dinosaurios para extraer sus órganos y salvar a los humanos. Pero cuando las criaturas escapan, los científicos tienen que luchar por sus vidas.

programme.title: Vacaciones en el Infierno
programme.desc: Detenido y encarcelado en una prisión mexicana por tráfico de drogas, un hombre aprende a sobrevivir en este entorno hostil con la ayuda de un niño de 9 años.

programme.title: USS Seaviper
programme.desc: El submarino alemán, U-234, del puerto de Kiel está intercambiando carga con los japoneses. USS Seaviper debe localizar y detener este peligroso intercambio.

programme.title: Inferno
programme.desc: Mientras un hombre conduce su moto por el desierto, unos matones le roban el vehículo y lo dan por muerto. Sobrevive y ya no piensa en el suicidio, porque ahora tiene un objetivo en la vida: vengarse y recuperar su moto.

programme.title: Scarecrow
programme.desc: Seis estudiantes de secundaria se enfrentan a una entidad maligna mientras cumplen su castigo antes del festival del espantapájaros del pueblo.

programme.title: Ataque en el Aire
programme.desc: Unos agentes rusos secuestran un avión comercial estadounidense y planean estrellarlo contra una central nuclear cerca de Washington D.C., lo que provocará una lluvia radiactiva que devastará la costa este. Con poco tiempo para que los cazas de la Fuerza Aérea lo derriben, los pasajeros y la tripulación del avión deben confiar en su propia formación militar y civil para detener a los terroristas antes de que sea demasiado tarde.

programme.title: Behewulf: la Leyenda Vikinga
programme.desc: Dinamarca, siglo VI. El rey danés Hrothgar y sus guerreros matan a un trol cuyo hijo, Grendel, jura vengarse.

programme.title: Alien Predator
programme.desc: Cuando un equipo de operaciones encubiertas es enviado a investigar el accidente de un avión no identificado, pronto se encuentran perseguidos por sus antiguos ocupantes.

programme.title: Asalto al Cine
programme.desc: Unos jóvenes en México planean un atraco a un cine, sin saber que sus vidas van a cambiar drásticamente tras el crimen.

programme.title: Dragones de Camelot
programme.desc: El reino de Camelot se ve sumido en la oscuridad después de la muerte del noble rey Arturo, cuando comienza el reinado de su cruel hermana, la hechicera Morgan. Con tres dragones a su mando y el uso de magia oscura, persigue a los Caballeros de la Mesa Redonda hasta los confines de la Tierra. Galahad sabe que para sobrevivir, deberán encontrar a su padre, Lancelot, que lleva años en el exilio.

programme.title: El Hombre del Presidente 2
programme.desc: Un especialista en contraterrorismo recibe el encargo del Presidente de seguir la pista de un terrorista sospechoso de planear la activación de un artefacto nuclear en Estados Unidos.

programme.title: Catástrofe Helada
programme.desc: Es Navidad y la nieve cubre cada rincón de un apacible pueblo. Sin embargo, la tragedia empieza cuando un terrorífico meteorito se estrella y amenaza con dejar congelada a toda la población, convirtiendo la blanca Navidad en una pesadilla de hielo.

programme.title: A Battle of Wits
programme.desc: L'histoire est centrée sur une bataille qui s'est déroulée pendant la période des États combattants en Chine, une série de guerres civiles qui s'est étendue du 5e au 3e siècle avant J.-C. Basée sur un manga japonais populaire, elle était elle-même basée sur un roman japonais inspiré de l'histoire des États combattants en Chine

programme.title: Le Meurtrier
programme.desc: Dans ce thriller d'action haletant, un chauffeur de taxi de Yanji, dans la préfecture autonome coréenne de Yanbian, au nord-est de la Chine, se rend en Corée du Sud à la demande d'un gangster local qui lui propose d'éliminer un professeur en échange du remboursement de sa dette. Parallèlement, il recherche sa femme, venue le rejoindre mais sans nouvelles depuis six mois. Ses soupçons d'infidélité le rongent, jusqu'à ce qu'un événement inattendu survienne cette nuit-là. Alors qu'il s'apprête à tuer le professeur, il se retrouve bientôt en fuite, traqué par la police et la mafia, donnant lieu à de violents combats et à d'intenses courses-poursuites.

programme.title: Le Manteau de Chicago
programme.desc: Le Chicago Outfit fut le syndicat du crime organisé le plus puissant du XXe siècle, et Lou Marazano (Frank Vincent) en était le tueur à gages le plus redouté.Vingt ans après sa vague de meurtres la plus célèbre, Lou est devenu une relique : sa légende s’est effacée, son talent oublié, et ses heures de gloire sont derrière lui.Mais lorsque l’arrestation d’un influent représentant syndical pour fraude fiscale menace de révéler une vaste conspiration impliquant policiers, élus et mafieux, le grand patron du Outfit (Armand Assante) ordonne l’élimination de témoins-clés.Pour Lou, c’est l’occasion rêvée de financer sa retraite et de fuir Chicago avec sa compagne (Kathrine Narducci).Mais deux détectives tenaces (Danny Goldring et Stacy Keach) se lancent à ses trousses, et le parrain par intérim (Mike Starr) décide de l’exclure du Outfit.Lou va devoir prouver qu’il mérite toujours son titre d’homme de main le plus meurtrier du Chicago Outfit — un titre qu’il n’a plus porté depuis plus de vingt ans…

programme.title: La Prison
programme.desc: UN ANCIEN POLICIER CONDAMNÉ REJOINT UN SYNDICAT DU CRIME SECRET AU SEIN DE LA PRISONYu-gon (KIM Rae-won), ancien inspecteur de police tourmenté, est incarcéré pour un délit de fuite. En prison, il découvre que tout l’établissement est contrôlé par un détenu nommé Ik-ho (HAN Seok-kyu), qui dirige un syndicat du crime avec l’aide du directeur et des gardiens, leur fournissant ainsi l’alibi parfait. Rapidement, Yu-gon devient un membre clé de l’empire criminel d’Ik-ho.

programme.title: Crash lunaire
programme.desc: Deux entreprises, l'une sidérurgique et l'autre aérospatiale, décident de s'associer afin d'exploiter les ressources de la Lune. Mais, un accident de forage provoque une fissure et précipite un morceau de l'astre sélène vers la Terre.

programme.title: Desert Strike
programme.desc: Un ancien militaire au passé mystérieux conduit un groupe de réfugiés égyptiens à travers le désert et doit les protéger d'un groupe de mercenaires diaboliques.

programme.title: Dystopia
programme.desc: Nous sommes en 2037. Notre monde se meurt lentement d'un virus qui a rendu l'humanité stérile. Aucun enfant n'est né depuis 25 ans. Les gouvernements sont devenus les marionnettes impuissantes des plus grandes entreprises et Biocorp, la plus grande du monde, ne cesse de promettre un remède qui ne viendra jamais

programme.title: Killerman
programme.desc: Moe Diamond est un blanchisseur d'argent à New York qui se réveille sans aucun souvenir, avec des millions de dollars en espèces volées et de la drogue. Il doit rapidement parcourir les rues à la recherche de réponses tout en essayant d'échapper à une équipe de policiers violents et corrompus.

programme.title: Yeti : Terreur en Montagne
programme.desc: Des amis partent à l'aventure dans la neige et tombent nez à nez avec une créature mortelle.

programme.title: Vampire Killers
programme.desc: Leurs femmes ayant été réduites en esclavage par la meute locale de vampires lesbiennes à cause d'une ancienne malédiction, les hommes restants d'un village rural envoient deux jeunes garçons malheureux dans les landes pour les sacrifier.

programme.title: Dragon Warriors
programme.desc: Un sorcier maléfique, Lord Tensley, cherche à obtenir la main et le cœur de la belle princesse, Lady Ennogard. Lorsqu'elle refuse, il l'enferme et libère un dragon mortel, qu'il contrôle, pour terroriser le pays. Il jure que, tant qu'elle n'aura pas accepté son amour, son dragon détruira tous ceux qui oseront montrer le moindre signe d'amour dans le royaume.

programme.title: Moving Target
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes dont la femme enceinte le pousse à trouver un emploi régulier se fait piéger pour meurtre dans une guerre entre gangsters russes.

programme.title: Shootfighter 2
programme.desc: Shingo et les garçons sont victimes de chantage pour aider Rawlins à infiltrer un réseau souterrain.

programme.title: Les Derniers Survivants
programme.desc: Au bord d’une vaste vallée aride, tout ce qui reste de la Wallace Farm for Wayward Youth, ce sont quelques carcasses de bâtiments abandonnés. Kendal, dix-sept ans (Haley Lu Richardson), se souvient à peine de l’époque où la vallée de l’Oregon était encore verdoyante. Cela fait dix ans qu’il n’a pas plu, et la société s’est littéralement évaporée. Kendal et les rares survivants subsistent tant bien que mal, rêvant de s’échapper. Lorsqu’un baron cupide de l’eau revendique ce qu’il reste de cette précieuse ressource souterraine, Kendal doit choisir entre fuir et se cacher ou se battre courageusement pour les quelques personnes et choses qui lui sont chères.

programme.title: Sagebrush Trail
programme.desc: Un hombre inculpado de asesinato escapa de la cárcel y se dirige al Oeste, donde se une a una banda en la que está implicado el verdadero asesino.

programme.title: Robin, Frecce, Fagioli E Karate
programme.desc: Un improbabile eroe si ritrova coinvolto in combattimenti e situazioni esilaranti tra azione e comicità. Diretto da Tonino Ricci.

programme.title: Los Profesionales del oro
programme.desc: Cuatro hombres se embarcan en una misión para desenterrar una fortuna en oro de una mina.

programme.title: Giulio Cesare Conquistatore Delle Gallie
programme.desc: Giulio Cesare guida l’esercito romano nella battaglia contro i ribelli in Gallia.

programme.title: Randy Cabalga Alone
programme.desc: Encarcelado por unos asesinatos que no cometió, Randy escapa sólo para tropezar con la guarida de los verdaderos asesinos.

programme.title: L'ira Di Achille
programme.desc: Sullo sfondo della guerra di Troia, Achille affronta battaglie e passioni travolgenti guidato dall’onore e dalla sete di vendetta.

programme.title: Sin refugio
programme.desc: Desde el primer momento en que el nuevo reverendo sube al púlpito, Liz sabe que ella y su familia están en peligro.

programme.title: Nel Segno Di Roma
programme.desc: Con Anita Ekberg e diretto anche dal grande Michelangelo Antonioni.Nell’antica Roma, guerre, alleanze e passioni si intrecciano mentre un impero lotta per imporre il proprio destino.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.sub-title: Bonanza - S1 EP19 - Los asesinos a sueldo
programme.desc: Hoss y Little Joe son confundidos con sanguinarios asesinos a sueldo en un pequeño pueblo de Texas dominado por dos familias enemistadas.

programme.title: La Spada E La Croce
programme.desc: Con Yvonne De Carlo, passioni e destino si intrecciano nella Roma attraversata da grandi cambiamenti.

programme.title: Los Dias de la Ira
programme.desc: Un desaliñado chico de la basura se convierte en el pupilo de un famoso pistolero, y el escenario para el enfrentamiento se prepara cuando el pistolero invade el pueblo del chico mediante la violencia y la corrupción.

programme.title: Samoa, Regina Della Giungla
programme.desc: Diretto da Guido Malatesta, con Edwige Fenech.Tra giungle inesplorate e pericoli nascosti, una coraggiosa regina guida il suo popolo contro invasori e tradimenti, tra azione e avventura.

programme.title: West of the divide
programme.desc: Ted Hayden se hace pasar por un hombre buscado y se une a la banda de Gentry sólo para enterarse más tarde de que Gentry fue quien mató a su padre. Salva de Gentry el rancho del padre de Virginia Winters y también rescata a su hermano Spud, perdido hace mucho tiempo.

programme.title: A Fistful of Lead
programme.desc: Cuatro forajidos del Oeste llevan a cabo un atraco a un banco en Bath Water, un pueblo de la fiebre del oro. Cuando el grupo sale en su persecución, las cosas empeoran, ya que los bandidos se dan cuenta de que han sido traicionados.

programme.title: Piena Di Grazia
programme.desc: Dopo la resurrezione, Maria guida i discepoli tra dubbi e speranza custodendo il messaggio destinato a cambiare il mondo.

programme.title: Genoveffa Di Brabante - La Lancia Della Vendetta
programme.desc: Accusata ingiustamente di tradimento, Genoveffa viene esiliata e costretta a sopravvivere nei boschi con il figlio, affrontando fame e pericoli mentre la verità cerca di emergere.

programme.title: El angel vengador
programme.desc: Miles Utley es un comando/guardaespaldas mormón profesional que se ve obligado a convertirse en renegado y a cuestionar su fe cuando investiga un escándalo de asesinato y especulación de tierras.

programme.title: UN AMENAZA EN LA SOMBRA
programme.desc: Tras el asesinato de su madre, un cazarrecompensas de armas tomar encuentra al padre que nunca conoció, que está librando una guerra en la pradera contra un poderoso barón de la tierra.

programme.title: Golia Alla Conquista Di Bagdad
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte, battaglie e colpi di scena, Golia affronta nemici e tradimenti per salvare Baghdad e difendere il regno. Diretto da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: Corsicana
programme.desc: El ayudante del sheriff Bass Reeves se reencuentra con su antiguo compañero y fugitivo Sam Tanner. Junto con un antiguo francotirador de la Unión, se enfrentan a una carrera contrarreloj para seguir la pista de Jack Donner y su despiadada banda de asesinos.

programme.title: Afrodite, Dea Dell'amore
programme.desc: Tra passioni proibite, intrighi di corte e sfide al potere, Afrodite intreccia destino e seduzione nel cuore del mito. Con Anthony Steffen e Isabelle Corey.

programme.title: Maciste Nelle Miniere Del Re Salomone
programme.desc: Tra deserti, miniere segrete e pericoli mortali, Maciste affronta una missione estrema alla ricerca del tesoro perduto.

programme.title: Ases y Ochos
programme.desc: Los pacíficos colonos de una ciudad destinada a la grandeza del ferrocarril se arriesgan a establecerse en el inexplorado Oeste y, de repente, son asesinados a tiros sin piedad. Sin ley ni orden, la justicia recae sobre los hombros de un anciano ranchero y un pistolero consumado pero retirado.

programme.title: Maciste Nella Terra Dei Ciclopi
programme.desc: Tra mostri, terre misteriose e battaglie leggendarie, Maciste affronta i ciclopi per salvare un popolo minacciato

programme.title: Lone Rider
programme.desc: Con un alentador drama familiar y una acción que sube la adrenalina, Lone Rider es un western con agallas, gloria y un poderoso mensaje. Bob Hattaway, un soldado honrado, regresa a su pueblo natal del Oeste para descubrir que el terrateniente corrupto Stu Croaker se ha convertido en el hombre más poderoso del condado.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Los Cartwright acuden en ayuda de un mozo de cuadra chino-americano acusado de asesinato. Enfrente tienen a un manipulador candidato a alcalde que quiere que todos los «extranjeros» abandonen Virginia City.

programme.title: Maciste Contro Lo Sceicco
programme.desc: Nel deserto tra insidie e duelli, Maciste affronta uno sceicco crudele per liberare prigionieri e salvare il regno.

programme.title: La Balada de Johnny Ringo
programme.desc: Un gángster supuestamente muerto quiere implicar a un hombre completamente inocente para que pague por sus crímenes y así poder dar esquinazo a sus vengadores y perseguidores.

programme.title: Maciste Gladiatore Di Sparta
programme.desc: Tra arene, rivolte e battaglie spettacolari, Maciste sfida il potere per liberare gli oppressi e cambiare il destino di Sparta

programme.title: La Vengeza de los cheyennes
programme.desc: Cuando Charlotte Sutter es secuestrada por los apaches, su hermano Sam, ayudado por un viejo prospector borracho, va en su busca.

programme.title: Ettore Fieramosca
programme.desc: Nell’Italia rinascimentale, il valoroso Ettore Fieramosca guida i cavalieri italiani nella celebre sfida contro i francesi, tra onore, rivalità e spirito patriottico.

programme.title: Los McMasters
programme.desc: Cuando un veterano negro de la Guerra Civil se convierte en copropietario del rancho sureño de los McMasters, los indignados veteranos confederados locales vienen a por él y su esposa india.

programme.title: Golia Alla Conquista Di Bagdad
programme.desc: Tra intrighi di corte, battaglie e colpi di scena, Golia affronta nemici e tradimenti per salvare Baghdad e difendere il regno. Diretto da Domenico Paolella.

programme.title: Les Femmes de Jesse James
programme.desc: Jesse James est tellement occupé à courir les jupons que sa carrière de hors-la-loi commence à en pâtir.

programme.title: Daniel Boone
programme.desc: Daniel Boone conduit des colons dans le Kentucky, mais il doit affronter les Indiens Shawnee qui ont été persuadés par un renégat français que Boone et les colons sont là pour les tuer et leur voler leurs terres.

programme.title: Une longue file de croix
programme.desc: Django et Sartana sont des chasseurs de primes qui éliminent des bandits dans une petite ville de l'Ouest. Un méchant propriétaire foncier fait entrer clandestinement des immigrants clandestins et les hommes qui travaillent pour lui payent la tête à un prix exorbitant. Il est donc logique que Django et Sartana passent un appel d'ici peu.

programme.title: Bonanza
programme.desc: Sur le point de partir pour une expédition de bétail, Ben engage un jeune vagabond nommé Sam Jackson comme l'un de ses conducteurs. Ce qu'il ne sait pas, c'est que Jackson est en réalité le hors-la-loi Johnny Logan, qui s'est engagé dans le convoi parce qu'il savait qu'il passerait près de la ville de Waycross, et Logan est déterminé à tuer le shérif de Waycross, qui est son père.

programme.title: O Cangaceiro
programme.desc: Après avoir pillé et massacré un village, le chef d'une bande de bandits, le capitaine Jagunço, enlève Flô, l'épouse du maire Cisso, et la torture.

programme.title: Django, le taciturne
programme.desc: La bande de Thompson attaque une caravane ; Bill, témoin involontaire, parvient à s'échapper et à sauver la vie de Linda. Tous deux se réfugient dans le village voisin, c'est-à-dire là où se trouvent les bandits.

programme.title: Vengeance aux deux visages
programme.desc: Après avoir braqué une banque mexicaine, Dad Longworth s'empare du butin et laisse son complice Rio se faire capturer, mais Rio s'échappe et part à la recherche de Dad en Californie.

programme.title: Bravo Django
programme.desc: Django Reagan est censé retrouver le coupable d'un vol, après avoir réussi à remettre la main sur l'argent volé. Il part à sa recherche dans le Montana, où la guerre fait rage entre éleveurs et colons.

programme.title: Et le vent apporta la violence
programme.desc: Un homme se venge de la famille responsable de sa condamnation injustifiée à dix ans de travaux forcés.

programme.title: Retour a Legend City
programme.desc: Enfant, il a vu son père prédicateur se faire assassiner. En tant que soldat, il a été témoin des horreurs de la guerre civile. Aujourd'hui, le chasseur de primes James Conners est de retour à Legend, au Nouveau-Mexique, pour capturer le baron terrien psychotique qui a détruit son enfance.

programme.title: Trinita va tout casser
programme.desc: Les victimes de Honey, le chef oppressif de la ville, reçoivent l'aide d'une alliance inhabituelle entre des hommes armés et des artistes de cirque.

programme.title: Amigo!... Mon colt a deux mots à te dire
programme.desc: Un vagabond aux poings rapides et un proxénète armé de pistolets rapides aident un enfant à réclamer son héritage.

programme.title: New Mexico
programme.desc: Un capitaine de cavalerie a beaucoup de mal à maintenir la paix entre son colonel tyrannique et un chef indien déterminé à se venger.

programme.title: On m'appelle King
programme.desc: Un chasseur de primes traque une bande de trafiquants d'armes à travers la frontière mexicaine.

programme.title: Les Pirates du Mississipi
programme.desc: Un groupe de pirates menés par Kelly, un bandit habillé tout en noir, sème la terreur en s'en prenant aux habitants de Helena et aux bateaux postiers sur le Mississippi. Le shérif James Lively doit aller contre la méfiance des habitants mais aussi des Indiens. Mais avec l'aide des Cherokees, car les bandits se sont établis sur leurs terres, et de son adjoint Tom Quincy, il parvient à mettre fin à leurs méfaits.

programme.title: Killer Kid
programme.desc: L'impitoyable et cruel capitaine Ramirez traque et tue les révolutionnaires dans sa quête du Saint, le chef vertueux de l'insurrection mexicaine contre les Fédéraux.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shantou
programme.desc: Join Tianran and Hannah in Shantou, Guangdong, as they explore the world of kungfu tea and its inseparable link to the local food. After sampling the finest teas the old city has to offer, they’ll try their hand at traditional crafts like inlaid porcelain and red peach pastries, all while taking in Shantou's coastal scenery and vibrant culture.

programme.title: Foodwise: Shaoguan
programme.desc: This time Tianran and Hannah are in the scenic city of Shaoguan in northern Guangdong, where northern and southern culinary traditions converge. There, they’ll sample rare teas from the Danxia landscape, savor mountain-grown dishes, and visit the great Hakka enclosures, learning how the history of migration has shaped the way people eat and drink. After trying their hand at making ancient-style rice noodles, they end their journey at a thousand-year-old temple, where the spirit of Zen tea brings their exploration to a peaceful close.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel comes face-to-face with the Philippine cobra, the most lethally venomous cobra on the planet. And in deep, dark caves on Palawan Island, the presenter searches for giant reticulated pythons sheltering from the heat of the day.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Infra-red cameras in the dead of night reveals a forest pit-viper sense and strike a target just fractionally warmer than its surroundings. Then there's the mussurana - a snake that not only eats other snakes but is immune to their venom.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: In the tunnels of a leafcutter ant nest, we uncover a Central American coral snake sharing the burrow. Nigel meets a rattlesnake without a rattle, and a young Mexican cantil uses its white tail tip to attract prey close for a deadly strike.

programme.title: Africa: The Serengeti
programme.desc: Chronicles a spectacle that few humans have ever witnessed, the Great Migration, taking viewers on a journey with over 1.5 million animals as they travel more than 500 miles across the Serengeti plains in Tanzania and Kenya.

programme.title: Quolls: Fast and Furious
programme.desc: A marsupial native cat has stalked the mountain tops of its northern domain for thousands of years. In the lush tropical rainforests of northern Queensland, the largest surviving marsupial carnivore on mainland Australia has remained isolated and hidden from sight… until now!

programme.title: Pharm to Table
programme.desc: How far would you go, to know what's in your food? As we go about our daily lives, few of us stop to wonder what our food is really made of. Taylor Lancastor travels 2800 miles on foot, to defend our right to know, and discover the truth of what we are being fed.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: The lions are on the hunt for giraffe. Meanwhile, researcher Rae accompanies the lions as they encounter nervy hartebeest. The game capture unit are tasked with supplying more zebra for the Ngama release site. And don’t miss the action as hungry Kwali zones in on an unsuspecting zebra. But can she hold on?

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: Phyre has to be darted to keep the balance in the pride healthy, while Pazza shows off her highly possessive nature with an unsuspecting tortoise. And Milo demonstrates why he wears the pants around here.

programme.title: Roaring With Pride
programme.desc: We follow the as they walk and stalk. Meat preparation gets weird for some as our volunteers make dinner time more interesting. A brave zebra stallion takes the fight to the ever confident lions. A historical moment is notched up for Wakanaka as she proves her predatory prowess.

programme.title: Anaconda - The Silent Killer
programme.desc: Few snakes are feared more and understood less than the anaconda. The film shows the journey into remote and uncharted parts of the Amazon rainforest to find the truth behind the mythical beast. Lush green forests abound with colorful toucans, noisy howler monkeys, strange tapirs, and vibrant Amazon Indian tribes. But hiding in the dense vegetation and murky swamps is also the biggest and most powerful snake in the world: the anaconda.

programme.title: Strange Creatures of the Batangas Sea
programme.desc: Hidden in the magical underwater world of one of the most biodiverse marine areas on the planet exists a community of spectacular animals more peculiar than we can imagine.

programme.title: Swimming with Legends
programme.desc: Shot over 2 years and in 9 different destinations, Swimming with Legends documents the life of a Belgium freediver Fred Buyle and his lasting fascination for the legends of the deep as described in ancient texts and mariner's nightmares.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: Scientists and engineers have long realized that Mother Nature is the world's most talented designer. Join host Joe Penna as he explores how designers are using Manta Rays to change the way we explore the ocean's depths. He'll fly a mechanical bird whose design is helping factories become more efficient. And he'll even watch a robotic hummingbird that's been created to help our soldiers stay safe.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: In 2050, the workplace will look far different than it does now, and one reason is robots. Join host Joe Penna as he talks to astronauts, designers and factory workers as they describe how the robotic revolution is affecting the way we work. One robot is designed to work side by side with humans, while another is puttering around the kitchen---a robotic butler that could be coming to your home soon.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: There will be two BILLION more people on Earth in 2050 and keeping them fed is a challenge not only for governments, but for scientists and futurists. Soon food will be grown in high rise buildings in major cities. Host Joe Penna talks to the people who are creating the foods of the future and samples everything from test tube beef to edible insects.

programme.title: Xploration Earth 2050
programme.desc: The dreams of generations of science fiction writers are now a reality. Man and Machine are meeting in strange—and productive—ways. Join host Joe Penna as he discovers a search and rescue robot that doubles as a tank, cuddles a therapy robot designed to look, and act, like an actual pet, and tests a high tech fireman's mask that has a lot more than X-ray vision.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: There are areas around the world where planes, ships, and people seem to vanish without a trace. These zones have been blamed for mysterious phenomena for decades. Each place has an enigmatic and haunting story that has inspired geologists, engineers and archaeologists to study the science behind the myth.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It is undisputable that despite their supposedly primitive technology, the societies that flourished almost 2000 years before Christ were able to accomplish unbelievable feats that forever changed the understanding of the world for all humankind.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: It was the Dark Ages… and from the cold North Sea a pagan maritime civilization exploded… and brutally raided and terrorized Europe… they were the Vikings.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: China is one of the world’s oldest civilizations and has one of the most well-­‐documented historical accounts in existence. Rich with records of early dynasties, warfare, ancient traditions and architecture, China is home to some of the most amazing archaeological sites in the world.

programme.title: Mysterious Earth
programme.desc: Lost civilizations, shipwrecks, sea creatures and sunken treasure…our oceans cover seventy-one percent of the Earth’s surface and yet, more than ninety-five percent is yet to be explored. This final frontier offers a hidden world of secrets to uncover.

programme.title: Secrets of the Universe
programme.desc: We are at the beginning of a period of unprecedented technological advancement, catalyzing a new age of scientific discovery. Travel with us on this immersive giant screen film, as we explore the most exciting machines ever conceived by man, including the Large Hadron Collider and James Webb Space Telescope. See how these new experiments allow us to look deeper into our origins, and unveil the mysteries of dark energy, dark matter and extra dimensions.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: These are the days of thirst: it is hot. Only the mountains are cool; everywhere else suffers in heat between 40 and 50°C. The rain is long forgotten. Each day is a search for shade and water. Amphibians bury themselves in mud to escape dehydration. The rest of the wild must wait for the cool of the night to move.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: As the woods prepare to sleep and mushrooms grow as the first rains fall, flocks of cranes migrate home to Spain from their summer season in the north. The stags clash their antlers in pursuit of the does; there is little time before winter sets in.

programme.title: Wild Iberia
programme.desc: The unknown face of Spain. Snow, rain, clouds, and cold envelop the land. The ibex migrate to the valleys, and wolves patrol the mountains as vultures circle the skies overhead. Though the landscape looks bleak and barren at a glance, there is life thriving here.

programme.title: Mummies: Secrets of the Pharaohs
programme.desc: Journey to the royal tombs of Egypt and explore the history of ancient Egyptian society as told through the mummies of the past. The film follows explorers and scientists as they piece together the archeological and genetic clues of Egyptian mummies, and provides audiences with a window into the fascinating and mysterious world of the pharaohs. To unwrap the secrets of the pharaohs is to perhaps glimpse the future of our own civilization.

programme.title: Dinosaurs Alive!
programme.desc: See the earliest creatures of the Triassic Period to the monsters of the Cretaceous in a 'life-sized' giant screen presentation. Join renowned paleontologists as they discover new fossils and uncover evidence that dinosaur descendants are still among us. Realistic and scientifically-accurate computer generated animation brings dinosaurs back to life -- in a big way!

programme.title: Wonders of the Arctic
programme.desc: Our ongoing quest to explore and come to terms with the Arctic is presented in the context of the crucial role that ice plays in the north. Ice is to the Arctic as trees are to the rainforest.

programme.title: Australia: Land Beyond Time
programme.desc: Stunning inside look at a land more like another planet than another country. Includes a rare natural event that happens only once every hundred years: the formation of a giant inland ocean out of nowhere in the middle of the harshest desert outback.

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Snakes are highly-adapted to survive in the scorching deserts of Arabia, and Nigel's skills are tested to find his top ten. Will the saw-scaled viper's venom and lightning reflexes be a match for the backwards strike of the puff adder?

programme.title: Ten Deadliest Snakes with Nigel Marven
programme.desc: Nigel explores almost every type of environment in China, climbing steep forested slopes and even wading into a sea cave to track down his top ten. But which is number one?

programme.title: 2H22
programme.desc: Au cours d’une nuit enneigée, une équipe de quatre cambrioleurs expérimentés planifie un vol de routine. Lorsque les choses tournent mal, l’amitié, la loyauté et la confiance qui les lient seront poussées à leur limite.

programme.title: Suspicion
programme.desc: Catherine rencontre Nick, un veuf, qu'elle épouse et avec qui elle emménage. Des choses étranges commencent à lui arriver dans son appartement. Est-elle en train de l'imaginer ou...

programme.title: La Disparue
programme.desc: Le corps de Yoon Seol Hee disparaît à l'Institut National d'Investigation Scientifique. Le détective Woo Joong Shik cherche des indices sur sa disparition, tandis que son mari Park Jin Han affirme qu'elle est en vie.

programme.title: Never Let Go
programme.desc: Une mère célibataire en vacances fait appel à la justice pour récupérer son enfant enlevé.

programme.title: Planning for joy (fr)
programme.desc: Alors que Claudia porte la robe de demoiselle d'honneur porte-bonheur qui a permis à toutes ses amies de se marier, elle se rend compte qu'elle cherchait l'amour au mauvais endroit.

programme.title: Le Ravisseur
programme.desc: Lorsqu'un policier apparemment exemplaire enlève et emprisonne secrètement une belle danseuse, une bataille mortelle s'engage entre le ravisseur et la captive.

programme.title: Coldwater
programme.desc: À Paris au XVIIe siècle, un élégant bretteur nommé D'Artagnan se retrouve opposé aux puissantes forces qui prennent le contrôle de la France. Il part venger le meurtre de ses parents et découvre un pays déchiré par le chaos et les troubles civils. Son cœur ne s’adoucit que pour Francesca, une fougueuse paysanne qui conquiert D'Artagnan au premier regard.

programme.title: En Transit
programme.desc: En 1946, un groupe de prisonniers de guerre allemands est envoyé par erreur dans un camp de transit pour femmes soviétiques et doit faire face à l'hostilité des détenues et des gardiennes soviétiques, sous les ordres du cruel commandant du camp, Pavlov.

programme.title: Deadly Ruphoria
programme.desc: Une rare soirée entre amies tourne au cauchemar pour Shana Jones, étudiante à l’université, lorsque Romeon Kingston, chef d’un réseau de traite des êtres humains, jette son dévolu sur elle.

programme.title: Supernova
programme.desc: Sam et Tusker voyagent à travers l'Angleterre dans leur vieux camping-car pour voir leurs amis, leur famille et des lieux du passé. Depuis le diagnostic de démence de Tusker, leur temps ensemble le plus précieux de tous.

programme.title: Troppa grazia
programme.desc: Lucia, mère célibataire, lutte pour trouver le bon équilibre entre sa fille adolescente, une histoire d'amour compliquée et sa carrière de géomètre. Son avenir professionnel est compromis lorsqu'elle réalise que la future construction d'un immeuble ambitieux s'avère dangereuse pour l'environnement en raison des cartes topographiques inexactes du conseil municipal.

programme.title: De l'Italie avec Amore
programme.desc: Ariel Moss aperçoit ce qu'elle pense être l'homme de ses rêves dans un restaurant local. Dans sa quête pour le revoir, elle rencontre Daniel, un séduisant restaurateur, qui l'aide à comprendre que le chemin vers son cœur passe peut-être par son estomac.

programme.title: Puzzle
programme.desc: Agnès, une mère de famille rangée vivant en banlieue, se découvre une passion pour les puzzles. Ce nouvel univers fait prendre à sa vie un tournant qu'elle n'aurait jamais imaginé.

programme.title: Romance en terre sauvage
programme.desc: Le veuf Markus part pour l'Afrique avec ses enfants katta et jakob, où il va diriger une station animalière. Malheureusement, ils doivent faire face à des braconniers. Mais Markus n'est pas seul, il y a aussi la garde-chasse Adriane..
